_comment: CLEAN-STRONG approach (a): train SPOT->SPOT on FULL history (data/npz_spot, 2023-01..2026-05, leak-free spot y_600), then post-hoc eval the test-fold preds against the LEAK-FREE CLEAN PERP target (perp~=spot 0.997+ in strong months) via swap_target_to_perp.py + perp_battery. This sidesteps BOTH prior failures: (a) leaked-target inflation (we use clean spot y), and (b) the 245-day cripple (clean-perp target only starts 2024-06/01; spot has full history). PROVEN milestone recipe = singh_alpha0_huber_track_reg_arch_spot_w540 (REG_arch + EMA0.999 + sigma-gate0.02 + dir_huber/utility_rank alpha0 + mag_focal). Only changes vs w540: npz_dir=npz_spot, fold_test_starts=STRONG(2025-02,2025-04), train_days=900 (=use ALL available history before each fold), test_days=28, val_days=60. epochs/patience=25 (proven; high patience avoids sigma-gate warmup trap). preload=false (npz_spot is 139GB; full-hist preload OOMs the 125GB cgroup). Each fold a SEPARATE process (--start-fold/--max-folds) to keep one training process at a time.
